final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_pulse FROM status_avgs), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse, a.avg_pulse - m.mean_pulse AS excess_first FROM status_avgs AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_pulse > m.mean_pulse), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_pulse FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT k.avg_pulse, k.excess_first, k.avg_pulse - m.mean_pulse AS excess_second FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_pulse > m.mean_pulse) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM final_kept
